summary: Frontend-only regression/visual test of the enhanced home screen with AI-generated hero images (domino/cards/mafia). All critical testIDs present, all 3 hero images load correctly (naturalWidth 1376x768, complete=True, rendered at 376x200), mafia 'مميزة' badge visible, navigation to /games/domino, /games/cards, /games/mafia works, and game-card-soon-1 is present with aria-disabled=true and does not navigate on click. Stat value for stat-games = 3 as expected. All core flows verified.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Currently set as prop on Animated.View for shine/title-shimmer. Non-blocking but should be moved into style.pointerEvents for RN web compatibility.
Console warnings: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated on web — use boxShadow/textShadow. Non-blocking.
Console warning: useNativeDriver not supported on web, falls back to JS-based animation. Expected on Expo web; no user-facing impact.

action_items: (Optional / low-priority) Move pointerEvents from Animated.View props to style.pointerEvents in HeroCard shine and title shimmer to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
(Optional) Replace shadow*/textShadow* StyleSheet keys with boxShadow/textShadow equivalents for web.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 517 lines — still within the 700-line threshold but growing; consider extracting HeroCard and FloatingBlob into separate files if additional games are added.
Image sources wired via require() and rendered correctly; overlay gradients keep titles legible.
Pressable uses `disabled={!game.available}` correctly, so soon-1 is non-interactive (aria-disabled=true confirmed in DOM).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home screen at / renders platform-home with 3 AI-generated hero images (domino, cards, mafia JPG, all ~750-925KB) loaded via require(). naturalWidth 1376x768 confirms Metro successfully bundled and served the binaries. Navigation to /games/{domino,cards,mafia} works. soon-1 card is aria-disabled and does not navigate. Stat card stat-games shows value 3. Featured مميزة badge overlay appears on mafia card (top-left). Only deprecation console warnings (pointerEvents, shadow*, textShadow*, useNativeDriver fallback) — none are blocking.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. All requested visual + navigation + element checks passed on 414x900 viewport after 12s load wait.
